findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: decode_zephyr_fatal, get_break_list, get_firmware_rules · Private data: lookup_register, check_registers, decode_registers, list_interrupts, check_interrupt_handlers, find_pins, decode_cortex_m_fault, decode_esp_panic, decode_zephyr_fatal, check_zephyr_conf, check_build_flags · Public sink: list_interrupts · Destructive: lookup_register, check_freertos_config, diagnose_symptom, get_debug_technique.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: decode_zephyr_fatal, get_break_list, get_firmware_rules · Private data: lookup_register, check_registers, decode_registers, list_interrupts, check_interrupt_handlers, find_pins, decode_cortex_m_fault, decode_esp_panic, decode_zephyr_fatal, check_zephyr_conf, check_build_flags · Public sink: list_interrupts · Destructive: lookup_register, check_freertos_config, diagnose_symptom, get_debug_technique

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
